text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria seeks clarification from European Union over Eurofor rapid intervention force planned by southern European nations.

- Universities and Scientific Research Minister Boubakeur Benbouzid writes to university teachers union saying teachers claim for more pay was fair but the government has no money to satisfy the demand.

- Algeria's ambassador to France says Air Algerie will resume flights to Paris next April. The Algerian airline had suspended its operations to Paris in 1995 in a row with French civil aviation authorities over terminal transfers.

- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia says in a campaign rally in Algiers the constitutional change to be submitted to referendum on November 28 will establish nationalist values of Algeria's war of independence.
